answer_2.quote: Explanation quality is assessed using BLEU (1-4), ROUGE-1/2/L, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: All human annotation was conducted on the original English versions of the premises and hypotheses... We measured inter-annotator agreement, yielding an average κ of 0.71... For explanations, annotators selected minimal EDU sets supporting their decisions, with high agreement (Jaccard: 0.91; span overlap: 0.94; conclusion: 1.00).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to select the minimal set of EDUs necessary and sufficient to support the inference, ensure cross-document coverage when required, and form a complete logical chain.
